title: How Warren Buffett's 'big error' may finally be paying off after a decade
summary: Warren Buffett’s $37 billion acquisition of Precision Castparts, once acknowledged as an expensive mistake, may finally be paying off. Supply shortages and GE Aerospace’s rival acquisition have reportedly lifted Precision Castparts’ value to about $100 billion.

title: In reverse flow, India exports 500 tonnes of hilsa to Bangladesh in two months: Fish traders
summary: Kolkata has exported approximately 500 tonnes of hilsa fish to Bangladesh recently. Another 150 to 200 tonnes are expected to be shipped in the coming weeks. This marks a significant reversal of the traditional fish trade flow between the two nations. Bangladeshi traders are sourcing hilsa from Gujarat, which has high demand there. The fish is also being processed for export and sold domestically

title: Arunachal Pradesh Frontier Highway: Clearing hurdles on road to 2029 target
summary: India's Arunachal Frontier Highway project is now on track for construction.  This strategic road aims to boost connectivity along the Chinese border.  Land acquisition issues and compensation disputes have been largely resolved.  The project completion deadline is set for the year 2029.  This highway will facilitate rapid movement of defence forces in the region.
